questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content: Among the following, the correct statement is:

options.content: Phosphates have no biological significance in humans.
Between nitrates and phosphates, phosphates are less abundant in earth's crust.
Between nitrates and phosphates, nitrates are less abundant in earth's crust.
Oxidation of nitrates is possible in soil.

questions.explanation: Due to greater solubility and nature to be prone to microbial action, nitrates are less abundant in earth's crust. Nitrates are soluble. In nitrates, nitrogen has maximum oxidation state and cannot be further oxidised.
